# Szmelc Conventions

> Global conventions for humans and AI agents, in six cores: CONVENTIONS (rules by category: WORKFLOW, GITHUB (repo, pull requests, actions, releases, deployments), SPECS (third-party and original document formats), FORMATS, SYSTEMS, REPO, DESIGN, INTERFACES, PACKAGING, CODE), AGENTS (always-on rules, agent behaviour rules, skills, adapters), HUMANS (install, browse), CONTRIBUTING (extend, write, version, prompts), SZMELC (organisation, projects index sources) and META (build pipeline, schema, templates). Agents load rules lazily: read INDEX.md, then only files whose trigger matches the task.

Entry points: [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/SKILL.md), [INDEX.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/INDEX.md), [index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/index.json). All stable rules in one file: [CONVENTIONS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS.md).

## Always on
- [Szmelc global rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/global/AGENTS.md): Installed as global instructions (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, QWEN.md, …); always active

## Cores
- [CONVENTIONS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/README.md): Load when asked which conventions exist, how rules are organised, or before adding/promoting/demoting a rule.
- [AGENTS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/README.md): Load when installing the conventions into an agent harness, or deciding on subagents, model or effort.
- [HUMANS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/HUMANS/README.md): Load when a person asks how to install, browse or use the conventions.
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONTRIBUTING/README.md): Load when adding, changing, promoting, versioning or indexing a convention, or contributing to this repo.
- [SZMELC](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/SZMELC/README.md): Load when asked about Szmelc itself, its public organisations and projects, the ecosystem, or the projects index.
- [META](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/META/README.md): Load when changing how this repo is built, checked, indexed or published (tools, schema, templates, site, CI).

## Rules
- [Token efficiency](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/RULES/EFFICIENCY.md): Load when choosing a model or effort level, configuring a harness or subagent, writing instruction files, or a session grows long.
- [Subagents & tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/RULES/SUBAGENTS.md): Load when considering a subagent, parallel work, skills/MCP use, or long-running commands.
- [Shell environment & dotfiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/CODE/DOTFILES.md): Load when building or changing a shell setup: rc files, dotfiles, plugins, prompt, shell integrations.
- [Go](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/CODE/GO.md): Load when writing, building or releasing Go code.
- [Naming](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/CODE/NAMING.md): Load when naming a repo, binary, package, env var, config key, file or doc.
- [Shell scripts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/CODE/SHELL.md): Load when writing or editing a shell script (bash, zsh, POSIX sh) or an installer.
- [Stack defaults](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/CODE/STACK.md): Load when starting a project or tool, or choosing a language or dependencies.
- [Colors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/DESIGN/COLORS.md): Load when any UI, TUI, CLI color, web page, theme, badge or graphic.
- [Code security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/GITHUB/CODE-SECURITY.md): Load when creating a repo, adding dependencies, or handling Dependabot, secret-scanning or code-scanning alerts.
- [Coding agents on GitHub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/GITHUB/CODING-AGENTS.md): Load when assigning issues to a coding agent, @-mentioning an agent on GitHub, or running an agent from a workflow.
- [Discussions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/GITHUB/DISCUSSIONS.md): Load when enabling GitHub Discussions, choosing categories, or moving threads between issues and discussions.
- [Issues](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/GITHUB/ISSUES.md): Load when creating, triaging or closing issues, or adding issue templates.
- [Organizations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/GITHUB/ORGANIZATIONS.md): Load when creating or maintaining a GitHub organization, its profile, teams, or org-wide defaults.
- [Projects](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/GITHUB/PROJECTS.md): Load when planning work across issues, creating or editing a GitHub Project board.
- [Pull requests & CI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/GITHUB/PULL-REQUESTS.md): Load when committing, pushing, opening/reviewing/merging a PR, or fixing CI.
- [Releases & versioning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/GITHUB/RELEASES/VERSIONING.md): Load when bumping a version, tagging a release, or planning a major version.
- [Labels](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/GITHUB/REPO/LABELS.md): Load when creating, editing or applying issue/PR labels, or setting up a new repo.
- [Repo metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/GITHUB/REPO/METADATA.md): Load when creating a repo, first push, release, or editing README/manifest/license.
- [Repo settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/GITHUB/REPO/SETTINGS.md): Load when creating a repo, changing its GitHub settings, merge options, rulesets or feature toggles.
- [Wiki](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/GITHUB/WIKI.md): Load when enabling a GitHub wiki or deciding where project docs live.
- [CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/INTERFACES/CLI.md): Load when building or changing a command-line tool.
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/INTERFACES/CONFIG.md): Load when adding a config file, options, env vars, or storage paths to a tool.
- [TUI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/INTERFACES/TUI.md): Load when building a TUI, or any project that has a CLI.
- [Arch packaging](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/PACKAGING/ARCH.md): Load when packaging, releasing, or adding install instructions.
- [Install & uninstall](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/PACKAGING/INSTALL.md): Load when writing an installer, a setup script, install instructions, or uninstall steps.
- [Nix packaging](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/PACKAGING/NIX.md): Load when packaging, releasing, or setting up a dev environment.
- [Repository layout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/REPO/LAYOUT.md): Load when creating a repo, adding top-level files or directories, or auditing a repo against the conventions.
- [Writing & voice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/REPO/WRITING.md): Load when writing docs, help text, error messages, commit messages, or community and lore text.
- [Design docs & agent briefs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/SPECS/ORIGINAL/DESIGN-MD.md): Load when starting a project, writing a brief for a coding agent, or changing a project's architecture.
- [Agent instruction files](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/SPECS/THIRD-PARTY/AGENTS-MD.md): Load when creating or editing AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, QWEN.md, Cursor/Copilot/Kiro/Windsurf rules, or llms.txt in any project.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/SPECS/THIRD-PARTY/README-MD.md): Load when writing or editing a project README.
- [Skills (SKILL.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/SPECS/THIRD-PARTY/SKILL-MD.md): Load when writing, editing, or installing an agent skill.
- [Branches](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/WORKFLOW/BRANCHES.md): Load when creating branches, opening/merging PRs, releasing, or promoting/deprecating a convention.
- [Commits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/WORKFLOW/COMMITS.md): Load when writing a commit message, PR title, or squash-merge title.
- [Finish every change](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/WORKFLOW/FINISH.md): Load when finishing a feature or fix, before calling work done.
- [Notifications](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/WORKFLOW/NOTIFY.md): Load when a job runs > ~10 min, or a failure needs a human.
- [Verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/WORKFLOW/VERIFICATION.md): Load when any code change.

## Skills
- [deep](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/AGENTS/skills/deep/SKILL.md): Escalate to deep reasoning for hard problems — architecture and design decisions, cross-cutting refactors, bugs with unclear root cause, security-sensitive code, concurrency, or anything where a wrong first approach is expensive. Use it before writing code for such tasks. Do not use it for routine edits.

## Experimental
- [v2 CLI & config contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/EXPERIMENTAL/CLI-CONTRACT.md): Opt-in only. Load when user opts into experimental conventions, or makes a tool wrappable by another tool or agent.
- [Localization (en + pl)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/EXPERIMENTAL/LOCALIZATION.md): Opt-in only. Load when user opts into experimental conventions, or adds user-facing strings, locales or translations.
- [Meta-grammar ("LEGO everything")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/EXPERIMENTAL/META-GRAMMAR.md): Opt-in only. Load when user opts into experimental conventions, or designs tooling that parses, lints or generates from these conventions.
- [Modules (KUR)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/EXPERIMENTAL/MODULES.md): Opt-in only. Load when user opts into experimental conventions, or builds a Kombinat/KUR plugin module.
- [v2 repo baseline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/EXPERIMENTAL/REPO-BASELINE.md): Opt-in only. Load when user opts into experimental conventions, or ports a v1 project to the v2 baseline.
- [Spec file taxonomy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/main/CONVENTIONS/EXPERIMENTAL/SPEC-FILES.md): Opt-in only. Load when user opts into experimental conventions, or designs Szmelc spec files (SZMELC.md, KOMBINAT.md, TEAM.md, MODULE.md, ASSERTIONS.md, POLICY.md, MEMORY.md).
